Looking at this question about hair cell regeneration with verteporfin in mouse models:

Verteporfin is a photosensitizing compound that has been studied in the context of cochlear hair cell regeneration. Research has demonstrated that verteporfin, when used in photodynamic therapy (combined with light activation), can promote hair cell regeneration in mouse models of cochlear damage. Studies have shown that verteporfin treatment leads to selective elimination of supporting cells, which then triggers a regenerative response resulting in new hair cell formation in the damaged cochlear epithelium.

This research has been published in studies showing that verteporfin can indeed induce hair cell regeneration in mouse models of hearing loss/wound.

[ANSWER]A[/ANSWER]
